For raw memories z,d, r_C=z-(K_d/T_a)*d; use this map for arbitrary initial values. Fixed flag=0 selects scaled electrical power feedback and flag=1 gate feedback. P_ref uses the selected feedback scale. clip(v,l,h)=min(h,max(l,v)); B(x,v,l,h)=0 if (x>=h and v>0) or (x<=l and v<0), otherwise v. Initial g is within bounds; constraint-preserving integration is required. PWL linearly joins (0,0),(g_1,p_1),(g_2,p_2),(g_3,p_3): on each segment use p_j+(p_(j+1)-p_j)*(g-g_j)/(g_(j+1)-g_j). Require 0<g_1<g_2<g_3,0<p_1<p_2<p_3,0<=G_min<G_max<=g_3. T_reg,T_a,T_b,T_w,A_tw,S_BASE,M_BASE,R_perm>0; T_z=A_tw*T_w; Vel_min<0<Vel_max; D_turb>=0. Other gains and initial memories are finite. Time is seconds; speed is pu and power/damping use compatible machine-power units."}

Feedback taps v_LV before the final clip. clip(x,l,h)=min(h,max(l,x)); HV=max and LV=min. The stated gamma stops outward amplifier derivatives at bounds and permits inward recovery. Initial V_A is bounded and constraint-preserving integration enforces it. T_B,T_B1,T_A,T_F>0; T_C,T_C1,K_LR,K_C>=0. V_IMIN<V_IMAX,V_AMIN<V_AMAX,V_RMIN<V_RMAX; E_t>0 and lo<=hi throughout operation. Remaining quantities and four initial states are finite. Voltage-like ports share compatible normalized control/field scales; I_FD,I_LR share a current base and K_LR,K_C convert current to voltage. Starred V_UEL occurrences share one signal; other starred/unstarred inputs remain distinct. Inactive additive/selector inputs must be externally zero/nonbinding."}

annotations.es:
<image>
A partir del diagrama de bloques de control o equivalente de la imagen, proporciona anotaciones DAE para el modelado dinámico, incluidas las unidades de control, las entradas, los estados, las salidas, las ecuaciones diferenciales y las ecuaciones algebraicas.
annotations.ar:
<image>
استنادًا إلى مخطط كتل التحكم أو المخطط المكافئ في الصورة، قدّم توصيفًا بنظام المعادلات التفاضلية الجبرية (DAE) للنمذجة الديناميكية، يتضمن وحدات التحكم والمدخلات ومتغيرات الحالة والمخرجات والمعادلات التفاضلية والمعادلات الجبرية.
annotations.fr:
<image>
À partir du schéma fonctionnel de commande ou du schéma équivalent présenté dans l’image, fournissez des annotations DAE pour la modélisation dynamique, comprenant les unités de commande, les entrées, les états, les sorties, les équations différentielles et les équations algébriques.
annotations.ru:
<image>
На основе структурной схемы управления или эквивалентной схемы на изображении представьте аннотацию в форме дифференциально-алгебраических уравнений (DAE) для динамического моделирования, включая блоки управления, входы, состояния, выходы, дифференциальные и алгебраические уравнения.

conversations.value:
<image>
请基于图中的控制/等效框图，输出用于动态建模的DAE标注，包含控制单元、输入、状态、输出、微分方程与代数方程。

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Speed lead-lag and lag","Power-reference sum and clip","Three turbine lags","Mechanical-power branch sum"],"inputs":["omega","P_0"],"states":["x_1","x_3","x_4","x_5","x_6"],"outputs":["P_mech = (1-K_2)*x_4+(1-K_3)*x_5+x_6"],"differential_equations":["d(x_1)/dt = (omega-x_1)/T_1","d(x_3)/dt = (lead-x_3)/T_3","d(x_4)/dt = (c-x_4)/T_4","d(x_5)/dt = (K_2*x_4-x_5)/T_5","d(x_6)/dt = (K_3*x_5-x_6)/T_6"],"algebraic_equations":["lead = K_1*(x_1+(T_2/T_1)*(omega-x_1))","c = clip(P_0-x_3,P_MIN,P_MAX)"],"notes":"x_1 is speed-lag memory, x_3 compensated speed-to-power output and x_4,x_5,x_6 turbine-lag outputs. T_2 is a numerator time coefficient. clip(v,l,h)=min(h,max(l,v)) limits the command c before the turbine lags. T_1,T_3,T_4,T_5,T_6>0 seconds; T_2>=0; 0<=K_2,K_3<=1; P_MIN<P_MAX. K_1 and five initial values are finite. omega is supplied normalized speed; K_1 maps speed to power. P_0,c,x_3,x_4,x_5,x_6,P_mech share a power base."}

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["classical synchronverter","omega_c decoupling","P-frequency loop","Q-voltage loop","PWM"],"inputs":["P_GFM_star","P_GFM","Q_GFM_star","Q_GFM","omega_0"],"states":["Delta_omega","omega_c","phi_m","u_m"],"outputs":["u_m*exp(j*phi_m)"],"differential_equations":["J*d(Delta_omega)/dt = (P_GFM_star-P_GFM)/omega_n-D_d*Delta_omega-D_a*omega_c","d(omega_c)/dt = K_i*Delta_omega","d(phi_m)/dt = omega_0+Delta_omega+omega_c","K*d(u_m)/dt = Q_GFM_star-Q_GFM"],"algebraic_equations":["u_ec = u_m*exp(j*phi_m)"],"notes":"Delta_omega is frequency deviation, omega_c integral decoupling compensation, phi_m phase and u_m voltage amplitude. u_ec=u_m*exp(j*phi_m) is the complex voltage command. J,K,omega_n,D_d,D_a,K_i are fixed parameters with J,K,omega_n!=0. P_GFM,Q_GFM are external measured powers, with supplied references and nominal frequency omega_0. Initial frequency, compensation, phase and amplitude memories are retained independently."}

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Two-area governors","Steam-turbine lags","Frequency-response lags","Tie-line integration and feedback"],"inputs":["U1","U2","dPL1","dPL2"],"states":["g1","t1","df1","g2","t2","df2","q_tie"],"outputs":["df1","df2"],"differential_equations":["d(g1)/dt = (e_g1-g1)/Tg","d(t1)/dt = (g1-t1)/Tt","d(df1)/dt = (Kp*e_p1-df1)/Tp","d(g2)/dt = (e_g2-g2)/Tg","d(t2)/dt = (g2-t2)/Tt","d(df2)/dt = (Kp*e_p2-df2)/Tp","d(q_tie)/dt = df1-df2"],"algebraic_equations":["e_g1 = U1-df1/R1","e_g2 = U2-df2/R2","dPtie = 2*pi*T12*q_tie","p2_tie_branch = -dPtie","e_p1 = t1-dPL1-dPtie","e_p2 = t2-dPL2-p2_tie_branch"],"notes":"g1,g2 are governor outputs, t1,t2 turbine outputs and df1,df2 frequency-response states. q_tie is the integral of df1-df2 before the 2*pi*T12 gain. dPtie is internal tie-line power; area 2 uses its negative branch. Tg,Tt,Tp,Kp,R1,R2,T12>0, with common Tg,Tt,Tp,Kp across areas. Seven finite initial values are supplied. U1,U2 are external commands and dPL1,dPL2 external load disturbances."}
